Isibuko SakwaZulu

NWU Vaal Campus cultural society

Imvelaphi yethu yisibani sethu. We keep isiZulu language, music, dance and heritage alive on campus.

Culture.
In motion.

Ingoma, isiZulu, beadwork and ubuntu. See what Isibuko SakwaZulu does on the Vaal Campus, from our weekly ingoma to events with other cultural societies.

What we stand for

Rooted in language, culture & community.

Isibuko means “mirror”. We reflect who we are, where we come from, and where we are going together.

Our story

Bringing our culture together at NWU Vaal.

Join Isibuko SakwaZulu at NWU Vaal Campus and be part of a vibrant community that celebrates culture, leadership and ubuntu. Step into your identity, build meaningful connections and proudly represent who you are.

Founded in 2025, we are open to all NWU Vaal Campus students.
